EN:
{{TAG:0003:000F:}}Oh yeah, {{TAG:0005:0008:}}!{{TAG:0007:0000:28000000}} {{TAG:0003:0000:}}Sorry about
being sick around you before!{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} I hope
you didn't catch my cold!
{{TAG:0003:0015:}}It was rough, but{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}ultimately I got 
better thanks to the {{TAG:0000:0003:0200}}medicine{{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}}
{{TAG:0011:0000:0000}} brought me! 
{{TAG:0003:001B:}}Being sick really taught me about
relying on others and knowing the
limits of one's superpowers!
ES:
{{TAG:0003:000F:}}¡Eh, {{TAG:0005:0008:}}!{{TAG:0007:0000:28000000}} {{TAG:0003:0000:}}Oye, perdona, que
antes estaba enferma...{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} ¡Espero
no haberte contagiado ni nada!
{{TAG:0003:0015:}}Estuve bastante chunga{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} pero ya
estoy mejor, ¡gracias a la {{TAG:0000:0003:0200}}medicina{{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}}
que me trajo {{TAG:0011:0000:0000}}! 
{{TAG:0003:001B:}}La verdad es que estar enferma te
limita un montón. ¡Imagínate, estar
en casa todo el día sin poder salir!
IT:
{{TAG:0003:000F:}}Oh sì, {{TAG:0005:0008:}}!{{TAG:0007:0000:28000000}} {{TAG:0003:0000:}}Non dev'essere
stato il massimo vedermi malata.{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}
Spero di non averti contagiat{{TAG:000E:0006:02006F0002006100}}!
{{TAG:0003:0015:}}Non stavo per niente bene ma{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}
poi la {{TAG:0000:0003:0200}}medicina{{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}} che mi ha portato
{{TAG:0011:0000:0000}} ha funzionato!
{{TAG:0003:001B:}}Questa esperienza mi ha insegnato
ad affidarmi agli altri e a capire
che forse non ho i superpoteri!
DE:
{{TAG:0003:0010:}}Hey, {{TAG:0005:0008:}}!{{TAG:0007:0000:28000000}} Du hast dich
ja gar nicht bei mir angesteckt!{{TAG:0003:0000:}} {{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}
Bist ein echtes Sonntagskind, was?{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0015:}}Ich war noch nie so krank, aber
wie heißt es so schön{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.?{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} Was dich
nich' umhaut, macht dich stark!
Und dank der {{TAG:0000:0003:0200}}Medizin{{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}}, die mir
{{TAG:0011:0000:0000}} gegeben hat, bin ich
jetzt so stark wie noch nie!
TRANSLATION:
{{TAG:0003:000F:}}Aa evet, {{TAG:0005:0008:}}!{{TAG:0007:0000:28000000}} {{TAG:0003:0000:}}Geçen sefer yanında
hastaydım, kusura bakma!{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} Umarım soğuk
algınlığımı sana bulaştırmamışımdır!
{{TAG:0003:0015:}}Zorluydu ama{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}sonunda {{TAG:0000:0003:0200}}ilaç{{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}} getiren
{{TAG:0011:0000:0000}} sayesinde iyileştim!
{{TAG:0003:001B:}}Hasta olmak bana başkalarına güvenmeyi
ve süper güçlerinin bile bir sınırı
olduğunu öğretti!

IT:
{{TAG:0003:000F:}}Oh!{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} {{TAG:000E:0003:}}{{TAG:0005:0008:}}!{{TAG:0007:0000:28000000}}{{TAG:0003:0000:}} Stai{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} bene?{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0015:}}Non vorrei averti attaccato
il raffreddore, l'ultima volta
che abbiamo parlato.{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:001B:}}Era un raffreddore parecchio
forte{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} Chiunque altro sarebbe
rimasto a letto per settimane!
Se {{TAG:0011:0000:0000}} non mi avesse
portato quella {{TAG:0000:0003:0200}}medicina{{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}}, sarei
ancora a soffiarmi il naso!

DE:
{{TAG:0003:0028:}}Boah!{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} Als wir das letzte Mal
gequatscht haben, hatte ich ja
'ne Mordserkältung!
{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}{{TAG:0003:0000:}}Ich sah bestimmt ganz schrecklich
aus{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} {{TAG:0007:0000:28000000}}{{TAG:0003:0009:}}Du hast doch keine Fotos

doch nie machen{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} {{TAG:0003:0010:}}Du hast dich aber

{{TAG:0003:0023:}}Die Erkältung würde ohne {{TAG:0000:0003:0200}}Medizin{{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}}

ES:
{{TAG:0003:0015:}}El otro día tenía un resfriado de
órdago{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} Ya sabes, ¡terrible!{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0025:}}Aunque al final conseguí curarme.
¡{{TAG:000E:0003:}}{{TAG:0011:0000:0000}} me trajo una {{TAG:0000:0003:0200}}medicina{{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}}
que me sentó de alucine!
{{TAG:0003:002B:}}Buf, menos mal que al final me he
puesto bien{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:28000000}} {{TAG:0003:0000:}}¡Un resfriado no es
moco de pavo!
IT:
{{TAG:0003:0015:}}L'altro giorno ero troppo
raffreddata{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} Cioè, è stato orribile!{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0025:}}Poi le cose si sono messe meglio,
dopo che {{TAG:0011:0000:0000}} mi ha portato
una {{TAG:0000:0003:0200}}medicina{{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}} niente male!
{{TAG:0003:002B:}}Devo dire che ho degli amici
coraggiosi{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:28000000}} {{TAG:0003:0000:}}Non è da tutti

DE:
{{TAG:0003:0028:}}Boah! Letztens ging's mir echt
tierisch dreckig{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} Ich meine, ich
war so was von krank!
{{TAG:0003:0025:}}Nachdem mir {{TAG:0011:0000:0000}} etwas
{{TAG:0000:0003:0200}}Medizin{{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}} vorbeigebracht hatte, ging's
mir aber gleich viel besser!
{{TAG:0003:002B:}}Toll, wenn man solche Kollegen hat.{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}
Man braucht 'ne Menge Mumm, sich
'ner Erkältung entgegenzustellen!

EN:
{{TAG:0003:0015:}}I caught a really bad cold a little
while back{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} {{TAG:0003:0009:}}It was awful!{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} I felt like
I lost a fight with a bulldozer.
{{TAG:0003:001B:}}I had a fever and a cough, and I
really needed some {{TAG:0000:0003:0200}}medicine{{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}}!{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:000A:}}Getting through it by myself made
me realize what I'm made of{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} I may
be tough, but everyone needs pals!
ES:
{{TAG:0003:0015:}}Hace poco estuve fatal por culpa de
un resfriado.{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} {{TAG:0003:0009:}}¡No moló nada!{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} Estaba
como si me hubiesen atropellado.
{{TAG:0003:001B:}}Tenía fiebre y tos... ¡pensé que no
lo contaba! {{TAG:0003:000A:}}Menos mal que soy una
chica muy dura y salí adelante.
{{TAG:0003:0027:}}Bueno, vale, fue gracias a la
{{TAG:0000:0003:0200}}medicina {{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}}que me tomé. ¡Pero
no se lo digas a nadie!
FR:
{{TAG:0003:0015:}}J'ai chopé un d'ces rhumes y'a pas

{{TAG:0003:001B:}}Fièvre, toux, et tout l'tralala... En

IT:
{{TAG:0003:0015:}}Fino a poco tempo fa ero alle prese
con il raffreddore{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} {{TAG:0003:0009:}}Terribile!{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}{{TAG:0000:0004:}}Mi sembrava di essere stata

{{TAG:0003:0015:}}Ich war bis vor Kurzem so was von
krank{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} {{TAG:0003:0009:}}Du kannst dir gar nicht
